subject: Riverbend pilot pricing — executive concession request
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@riverbend.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing proposal for Riverbend pilot — Hosted API

Hi Sanjay,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday — appreciate the context on the inference footprint and the pilot goals. Attached is a concise pricing deck and a draft SOW for a 3-month pilot (with optional scale to production). Highlights:

- Recommended pilot: 1M tokens/month initial, expected ramp to 3M by month 3
- Standard hosted API list price: $0.015 / 1K tokens (embedded in the attached deck)
- Proposed pilot concession: 20% off list for months 1–3 when Riverbend signs the SOW and provides a reference quote

Attachments: Riverbend_Pricing_Deck_20270504.pdf, SOW_Riverbend_v1.docx

If you need a tighter price to get internal signoff on procurement, tell me the target number and any procurement constraints. We can route an exec-sanction if needed but would want a short-term commit in return.

Best,
Mina

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@riverbend.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@riverbend.ai
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing proposal for Riverbend pilot — Hosted API

Mina,

Thanks for the deck. Riverbend leadership reviewed and they asked if we can get to a 40% off list price for the pilot and similar concession for year 1 if we convert to production. Procurement said they need an approved exec-level concession to pass our internal review — otherwise the finance team will hold the purchase.

We can commit to a 12-month minimum if Redwood will provide a 40% concession for the first 3 months and 30% for months 4–12. We also need a standard SLA and data residency confirmation (US region). Can you escalate this? Procurement is time-boxed — we need a decision in 48 hours.

-Sanjay
VP Product, Riverbend AI
procurement@riverbend.ai

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Riverbend pricing — exec sanction needed (timed request)

Folks, forwarding Sanjay's request — procurement is asking for up to 40%/30% blended depending on conversion. My read: strategic account, strong reference potential, likely 1M -> 3M token run-rate in 3 months, but we should be careful on unit economics.

Recommendation: offer 25% off list for first 12 months in exchange for a 12-month committed spend with auto-renew and a short joint PR/customer quote plus a 30-day ramp milestone (1M by month 1, 2M by month 2, 3M by month 3). Legal has flagged two small redlines in the attached redline.

Why 25%? It preserves healthy yield while giving Riverbend meaningful headroom vs the 40% ask. It also keeps us within the threshold I believe we can clear with senior execs without compromising pricing integrity for similar accounts.

Time sensitive: procurement asked for a decision within 48 hours. Please advise if you can approve or if we need to escalate to the CRO/CEO.

Attachments: RB_Redline_Contract_20270504.pdf

Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Riverbend pricing — exec sanction needed (timed request)

Mina / team,

Approve a 25% executive concession for Riverbend for the first 12 months under the following conditions:

- 12-month committed spend (minimum monthly billing guaranteed in SOW)
- Auto-renew clause after year 1 unless 60 days' notice given
- Ramp milestones documented: 1M tokens month 1 / 2M month 2 / 3M month 3; failure to meet ramp reduces concession to 15% for remainder of term
- Legal to finalize redlines; revenue ops to record concession in pricing playbook and HubSpot deal as an approved exception

I want the concession documented in a single-page approval note (signed) and saved in the deal record. Marissa / Markus, please action legal + doc prep and route to DocuSign once finalized.

Ben Carter
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.inference.com
+1 (650) 555-0123

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@riverbend.ai>
Cc: procurement@riverbend.ai, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Approved: Riverbend 25% concession for Hosted API pilot (terms & next steps)

Hi Sanjay — good news. Our leadership has approved a one-time executive concession of 25% off list pricing for the first 12 months, subject to the conditions below.

Summary of approved terms (final to be captured in SOW / DocuSign):
- Concession: 25% off Redwood Hosted API list price for months 1–12
- Commitment: 12-month minimum term (monthly minimum billing in SOW)
- Ramp milestones: 1M tokens by end of month 1, 2M by end of month 2, 3M by end of month 3; if Riverbend fails to meet ramp, concession drops to 15% for remaining term
- SLA: Standard enterprise SLA (US region). Legal will confirm data residency language in the final SOW.
- PR/reference: Riverbend agrees to a short customer quote and joint intro call with our marketing team after month 2 if ramp is on track

Next steps:
1) Marissa / Markus to finalize redline and route to DocuSign (link to follow).
2) Procurement to sign SOW + DocuSign.
3) We’ll spin up the pilot in us-west region as soon as DocuSign is complete.

Attachments: ApprovedConcession_25pct.pdf (executive approval memo)

Thanks — we’ll follow up with the finalized DocuSign link in the next few hours.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
